body:
Now per game day: pizza 120-705 (Mon-Fri), designer 60-390, teacher 150-390, hairstylist and photographer 60-480.
New: raise the bottom so a bad day still pays, keep the top:
- Designer room: 20/50/90/130 -> 40/70/100/140
- Teacher class: 75/135/195 -> 90/150/210
- Hairstylist and photographer 1 star: 15 -> 30
Pizza stays (it is the weekday rush job).
Effect: a middle job day about 290 -> 330. With Balances 1-4, the job is clearly the best way to earn.

comments.text: Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.

short: Jobs pay more on a bad day
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team
title: Balance 5: jobs become the main income (small raise)
